backlog.title: PDF generation endpoint
backlog.spec:
Add POST /v1/pdf that generates a PDF of the current or specified page.

Files to modify:
- src/api.ts — add /v1/pdf route

Endpoint: POST /v1/pdf
  Body: { url?: string, format?: 'A4' | 'Letter', landscape?: boolean }
  Response: binary PDF (Content-Type: application/pdf)

Implementation:
  - Require active session (400 if none)
  - Connect via puppeteer-core
  - If url provided, navigate first
  - page.pdf({ format: body.format || 'A4', landscape: body.landscape || false, printBackground: true })
  - Return raw PDF buffer with Content-Type: application/pdf
  - Disconnect

Pattern: follow existing /v1/screenshot structure (returns binary).
Do NOT add new dependencies.
